question: In ΔMNO, ∠N = ∠O and NO = 12 cm, MO = 10 cm and MP be the altitude, then the length of MP is:
solution:
**Given:**

A triangle MNO

angleN = angleO, NO = 12 cm 

MO = 10 cm and MP = Altitude

**Concept used:**

If two angles are equal then, then the sides opposite to those angles are also equal

Isosceles triangle = It is a triangle that has two sides of equal length

Height of an isosceles triangle = sqrt{a² -( b²)/(4)} 

Where a = equal sides and b = base of the triangle 

**Calculation:**

Figure drawn below according to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/290dea9225f4cdeae853cd5a6a1c05e08354990757430253c11fa485f4573f31.png] 

Here, we have a triangle MNO 

angleN = angleO ⇔ so, the sides opposite to it i.e. MO = MN 

So, this triangle is an isosceles triangle as it has two of its sides equal

Also, MO = MN = 10 cm [Length of the equal sides]

Base of the triangle ON = 12cm and altitude = height of the triangle = MP

Height of an isosceles triangle (MP) = sqrt{a² -( b²)/(4)} 

Here a = length of the equal sides = 10 cm , b = base (ON) = 12 cm

 ⇒ sqrt{10² - (12²)/(4)} 

⇒ sqrt{(100 - (144)/(4))} 

⇒ sqrt{(100 - 36)} 

⇒ sqrt{64} = 8 cm

**Hence , the length of altitude (MP) is 8 cm.**.
